name: Red Cedar River
gaugeName: RED CEDAR RIVER NEAR COLFAX, WI
blurb: Red Cedar River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.takeOut: Red Cedar River Access — Town of Rice Lake
sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.

notices.title: Mikana launch
notices.text: Put in below the dam at the designated park access west of Highway 48. Stay clear of the dam and chute; the county guide notes rocky shallows downstream.
notices.sourceName: Barron County — paddling guide in June 2022 committee packet

sections.routeReview: Rice Lake Dam requires a land carry and street crossing. A continuous dotted river path is withheld.

notices.title: Rice Lake Dam portage
notices.text: The county guide places the portage at the south end of Rice Lake Dam, continuing west across Main Street to the river access. Follow current signs and confirm the carry before launching.
notices.sourceName: Barron County — paddling guide in June 2022 committee packet

sections.accessReview: Dam crossing/portage unresolved: Cedar Falls. A legal, usable route around the barrier has not been established. Do not plan this as a continuous float.
sections.routeReview: This section includes Cedar Falls and needs a closer check of the landing or portage. Consult the agency guide and signed access; do not assume you can paddle through a dam.
